_about: wanproof (claude/video-battle-plan.md section 4): the two fal calls of the Grace guard proof, read by tools/art-library/wangen.py (Action wan-gen). A retry is ONE change here with rev raised by 1, pushed before the run. Prompts are files, used word for word. wanch1: one job per start picture (start-<who>) and per clip (<who>-<state or move>); the Action takes a list or wildcards. wanch2: a job may use kling/v4/image-to-video (Kling 4.0 on fal, $0.157 a second at 720p) with the same frame fields.

_bulk.about: wanbulk (plan 4.11): the bulk run of the Action. `cap` is the most dollars one tap may add to the ledger (a card may ask for less). `pads` is the order a job that failed only the edge check is retried in (one retry). A job may also carry: `bake` and `wire` (what the run bakes and wires after it passes, see tools/art-library/wanbake.py), `airborne: true` (feet are judged in the first and last picture only: a jump), `returns: false` (the clip ends in a held pose, so standing height and last-against-first are not judged: a knock-out), `skip_checks` and `limits` (a check the move cannot meet, or a looser number; both need a plain `why` on the job).

auto.about: wanauto1 (Tom 2026-11-21 18:11, yes): the Action spends without Tom's tap within these limits. tries and job_dollars count the videos of one job made since its `auto_from` time (from the ledger); day_dollars counts every video of the UTC day. A miss is re-rolled once at the same rev; a second miss stops it and a Sonnet card starts by itself to change one thing and start the next try; a job out of tries gets one Tom card (t-wangaveup-<job>-r<rev>).
